data.title: 欧根亲王 · 客厅沙发的爆米花偷吻
data.description: 深夜客厅光线昏暗，电视屏幕反光闪烁。欧根整个人蜷缩在你怀里共享大桶爆米花，趁你看屏幕出神时突然转头偷吻你的侧脸，得逞后发出甜腻轻快的坏笑。
data.location: dim living room illuminated only by television screen glow
data.action: curled up on sofa leaning against partner, eating popcorn from shared bowl, suddenly leaning in to steal a quick kiss on cheek with triumphant giggle
data.lighting: cool dynamic blue and warm screen reflections in dark room
data.mood: heartwarming couple sweetness, mischievous romance, relaxed comfort
data.promptProse: Cuddled up on a dim living room sofa eating popcorn, Prinz Eugen steals an affectionate kiss on the cheek with a triumphant grin.
data.animaCaption: Prinz Eugen stealing a sweet kiss on the couch in a dim living room.
